summary: PureCycle Technologies filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered offering of $250M 4.75% convertible senior notes due 2032. The notes convert at 90.2242 shares per $1,000 principal (~$11.08 conversion price) and are redeemable at PureCycle's option after July 2029 if stock exceeds 130% of conversion price. The offering is accompanied by a concurrent $17.57M-share stock offering at $8.21/share. Proceeds will repurchase up to $216M of existing 7.25% green convertible notes. This is a routine capital markets financing, not a special situation; the filing describes a convertible debt issuance and concurrent stock offering to refinance existing convertibles.
